headline: COLREG Rule 13: Overtaking
subheadline: Coming up from astern? Keep clear.
insight: A vessel coming up from more than 22.5 degrees abaft the other's beam is overtaking. She keeps out of the way until she is finally past and clear.

meta.description: COLREG Rule 13: any vessel overtaking keeps out of the way of the vessel being overtaken, until finally past and clear.
meta.question: How do you confirm you are past and clear?
